events.name: Compositions: An Evening Of Katie Jenkins
events.info: Pointeworks presents COMPOSITIONS: An Evening of Katie Jenkins, a celebration of Resident Composer Katie Jenkins featuring three original ballet commissions performed with live music. Curated by Artistic Director Sophie Williams, the evening brings together an international cast of world-class artists for a program dedicated entirely to female voices in both choreography and composition. The program features the return of Laine Habony's Chasing Shadows, a striking piano solo work, alongside Jacquelyn Long's Moving Forces for six dancers, piano, and violin. The evening culminates in a world premiere by acclaimed choreographer Hélène Simoneau, featuring a soaring new score for live string quartet.

events.name: Vienna Royal Orchestra: Viva Mozart 270
events.info: VIENNA ROYAL ORCHESTRA:VIVA MOZART 270 Matthew Busse, Conductor Tian Jiang,Piano Shay Mowbray, piano Anson Wong, piano From Carnegie Hall to Jacobs Music Center... Following its New York performance this summer at Carnegie Hall, the Vienna Royal Orchestra brings its VIVA MOZART 270 celebration to Jacobs Music Center in San Diego. This special concert honors the 270th anniversary of the birth of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, one of history's most beloved and influential musical geniuses. Audiences will enjoy an inspiring program of Mozart's timeless masterpieces, performed by distinguished musicians from Europe and the United States. Internationally celebrated pianist Tian Jiang appears as soloist in Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 23 in A Major, K. 488. Praised as "a thoughtful interpreter" by The New York Times and "a deeply persuasive Mozartean" by The Los Angeles Times, he is recognized for performances that combine poetic artistry, technical mastery, and expressive depth.
